facts.text: Trailing-twelve-month revenue is ₹3,899 cr, +35% on the prior twelve months.
Trailing-twelve-month PAT is ₹345 cr, +9% on the prior twelve months.
Jun 2026 quarter: revenue ₹946 cr (+41% YoY), PAT ₹56.0 cr (−25% YoY), operating margin 15.6%.
Revenue has compounded at 54% over 5 and 48% over 3; the last twelve months (+35%) are running behind the 3-year pace.
Profit and revenue have compounded at a similar pace over 3 years (51% vs 48%).
Operating margin is steady at 15.6% (16.8% a year ago).
Borrowings are ₹913 cr against equity of ₹4,748 cr: debt/equity 0.19× (was 0.16× in Mar 2023).
Operating profit plus other income covers interest 6.0× over the last twelve months.
Capital work-in-progress is ₹511 cr, 32% of fixed assets — a large build-out not yet earning.
The cash conversion cycle has lengthened to 193 days from 162 in Mar 2023 (debtor days 74 → 154, payable days 103 → 131): more cash is tied up in operations.
Promoters hold 53.3%, −0.1 pp over a year.
Foreign institutions hold 6.1%, −4.6 pp over a year.
Over 5 years the business reported ₹1,516 cr of operating profit but operating cash flow was −₹615 cr: profits have not turned into cash.
Free cash flow was negative in 5 of the last 5 years; cumulative −₹3,288 cr, latest year −₹1,841 cr.
Capex ran at 34% of revenue in Mar 2026, about ₹1,241 cr (averaged 20% over the three years before).

business.what: Kaynes Technology is an electronics system design and manufacturing (ESDM) company. It provides integrated services including R&D, product design, manufacturing, testing, and full lifecycle management for sectors like automotive, industrial, medical, telecom, and consumer electronics.
business.geography: The company operates within the Indian economy, which is described as a high-growth economy, while navigating global macroeconomic pressures and supply chain realignments.

claims.claim: Kaynes is the number one in meter installation across the country.
claims.quote: I want to reiterate amongst all the metering companies which are doing assembling, we continue to be the number one installation done across the country than any other competition.

claims.claim: Receivables from the leading EV two-wheeler customer have come down significantly to below INR100 crores.
claims.quote: the receivable from our leading electric vehicle two-wheeler customer, where on most of your right the concern, has come down significantly to below the INR100 crores

claims.claim: Total investment in OSAT and PCB is around INR1,250 crores.
The company has not seen a structural deterioration in demand, order book quality or customer relevance.
claims.quote: The company has not seen a structural deterioration in demand, order book quality or customer relevance.

claims.claim: The company aims to increase the contribution of NPD-led and value-added solutions to nearly 30% of total revenue.
claims.quote: our goal is to steadily increase the contribution of NPD-led and value-added solutions to nearly 30% of the total revenue in the coming years.

claims.claim: The core EMS business has demonstrated significant improvement in working capital efficiency, reducing days from 83 to 53.
claims.quote: the core EMS business has demonstrated a significant improvement in the efficiency as committed earlier with the working capital days reducing from 83 days in FY '24 to 53 days in FY '26.

claims.claim: The company's order book is growing at 50% per annum.
claims.quote: order book health has been good. We are growing at about 50% per annum basis, and that's the monthly order inflow.

claims.claim: The company has received FSA approval for its OSAT facility at Sanand.
claims.quote: A key area of concern for many stakeholders have been the approval of the FSA under the ISM framework for OSAT. I am pleased to confirm that this approval is now in place.

claims.claim: The company expects to be operating cash flow positive at the consolidated level for the full year.
claims.quote: So this year, you can expect at consol level, definitely a significant positive operating cash flow.

claims.claim: The company expects margins to remain strong and continue the upward trend in the second half of the year.
claims.quote: In fact, across the verticals, we have had gross margins sustaining up and showing up... In the second half also, you can expect this trend to continue.

claims.claim: The company expects to achieve significant positive operating cash flow by the end of the fiscal year.
claims.quote: we think that we'll be able to give you a -- significant positive OCF by the year-end.

claims.claim: The company is seeing strong demand and is being qualified by a large global company for RF testing equipment.
claims.quote: one of the very large companies in the world, they are visiting our facility in Chamarajanagar to qualify us... the business is pretty strong.

claims.claim: EBITDA margin expansion of 350 basis points year-on-year for Q1 FY26.
claims.quote: This translates into EBITDA margin expansion of 350 basis points over Quarter 1 FY '25.

claims.claim: The company is targeting 15% of the total smart meter market.
claims.quote: So smart meter, like we said, we are aiming at about 15% of the total market.

claims.claim: OSAT facility in Sanand is on track for commercial production by December 2025.
claims.quote: OSAT facility in Sanand is almost there with proto products for AOS and is on track to be fully operational for commercial production by December '25.

claims.claim: Multilayer HDI PCB plant in Chennai is expected to be operational by January 2026.
claims.quote: the multilayer HDI PCB plant in Chennai has also reached the final stages with building construction complete and operational readiness expected by January 2026.

claims.claim: The order book contains orders which are higher margin than what we are delivering right now.
claims.quote: suffice it to say that the order book today contains orders which are higher margin than what we are delivering right now.

claims.claim: We are well positioned to present a compelling opportunity to these customers more comprehensively, positioning the Canada-India alliance as a strategic alternative to China-based sourcing.
claims.quote: positioning the Canada-India alliance as a strategic alternative to China-based sourcing.

claims.claim: Construction for OSAT plant in Sanand, Gujarat and HDI PCB plant in Chennai is in full swing, and we are in line with meeting the deadlines of completing the construction by year-end.
claims.quote: Both the plants’ construction is in full swing, and we are in line with meeting the deadlines of completing the construction by year-end.

synthesis.one_liner: Kaynes delivers rapid revenue growth of 35% but burns cash heavily, with negative free cash flow accumulating to ₹3,288 cr.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: The company guided for 60% revenue growth in FY26 and consolidated revenue of ₹4,500 cr.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Revenue grew 33.2% in FY26 to ₹3,626 cr, missing the guided target of ₹4,500 cr.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management expects operating cash flow to be positive for the full year.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Free cash flow was negative in 5 of the last 5 years, totaling -₹3,288 cr.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: The core EMS business has improved working capital efficiency, reducing days from 83 to 53.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: The total cash conversion cycle lengthened to 193 days from 162 in Mar 2023, with debtor days rising to 154.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: The company expected EBITDA margin to exceed 15.6% and expand by 50 basis points.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: FY26 operating margin reached 15.9%, achieving the guided expansion and remaining steady at 15.6% in Jun 2026.

synthesis.credibility: Management shows a mixed track record with guidance, delivering on two margin targets while missing two major revenue goals. Historical profits have failed to convert into operating cash flow.

bull.evidence: Trailing-twelve-month revenue is ₹3,899 cr, up 35% on the prior twelve months.
Borrowings are ₹913 cr against equity of ₹4,748 cr, resulting in a low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.19x.
FY26 operating margin of 15.9% met the guided expansion of 50 basis points.

bear.evidence: Cumulative free cash flow is negative ₹3,288 cr over the last 5 years.
The cash conversion cycle increased to 193 days, driven by debtor days rising to 154.
Capital work-in-progress stands at ₹511 cr, representing 32% of fixed assets not yet earning.

watch: Whether operating cash flow turns positive by the end of the fiscal year.
Progression of debtor days and working capital efficiency.
Commercial production milestones for OSAT and PCB facilities.
